panel.auth-hint: Credentials are sent to OpenVPN 3 and are not stored.
panel.auth-hint-saved: Username and password are saved in the system keyring after a successful connection. One-time codes are never saved.
panel.dco-hint: Kernel-accelerated tunnel. Needs the ovpn-dco kernel module.
panel.go-to: Type a path and press Enter
panel.log-empty: No log lines yet. Events appear as they happen.
panel.name: Name (optional)
panel.no-profiles-hint: Add an .ovpn file to get started.

opt.auth-fail-retry-hint: Ask again instead of giving up when the server rejects the credentials.
opt.autoconnect-hint: Connect this profile automatically when Noctalia starts. Only one profile can do this.
opt.dns-disabled-hint: Leave the system resolver untouched while connected.
opt.dns-google-hint: Use 8.8.8.8 if the VPN provides no DNS server.
opt.legacy-hint: Allow old ciphers some servers still need. Less secure.
opt.proxy-password-hint: Leave empty to keep the current one
opt.server-hint: Connect to this host instead of the profile's

panel.persist-tun-hint: Keep the tun device and routes up while reconnecting.
panel.web-auth: Continue the sign-in in your browser
panel.web-auth-hint: A browser window should have opened. This closes by itself when you are connected.

connect_timeout.description: How long to wait for a connection before giving up.
connect_timeout.label: Connect timeout (seconds)

default_profile.description: Profile name as shown in the panel. Used by the Control Center tile and the bar's right click. Empty uses the first profile.
default_profile.label: Default profile

notifications.description: Notify when a connection is made, lost, paused or fails.
notifications.label: Notifications

poll_seconds.description: How often sessions and traffic are polled.
poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)

remember_credentials.description: Save the username and password of each profile in the system keyring (secret-tool) after a successful connection, and fill them in next time.
remember_credentials.label: Remember credentials

single_session.description: Disconnect other sessions before connecting a new profile.
single_session.label: One session at a time
